question: Do four explicitly encoded ternary invariant patterns evolve exactly as their reduced scalar oracle under the unchanged baseline Rule3 for every registered remainder and seed?
scope: An independent registered replication family. The user-reported runs did not supply exact board sizes and seeds, so this is not claimed to reproduce those unprovided inputs. These are globally prepared invariant sectors on periodic cubes, not localized particles, traveling signals, physical mass or linear superposition.

baseline.remote_tree_equivalence: The project manager independently read PR11 metadata; integration fetched the remote Git commit and verified both commits have tree09840e0ffdf158950332e10b05334212ab652378. This receipt records that supplied remote verification; native source bytes are preserved separately.

patterns.definition: v(x,y,z,g)=(1,-1,0)[x mod3], identical in all48 channels
v(x,y,z,g)=(1,0,-1,0)[x mod4], identical in all48 channels
v(x,y,z,g)=R(g)[1][1]=(R(g)e_y)_y, identical at every site; R is independently constructed from exact4x4 matrices with the documented Cx-then-Cy BFS channel convention.

encoding.meaning: Only initial integer triples are prepared. Every channel, including zero-pattern channels, then evolves by the same native Rule3 and fixed coupling. The signed remainder involution preserves parity. There are no channel-dependent coefficients or runtime pattern projection.

scalar_oracle.initial: The declared counter seed and one declared base remainder. Encode the resulting scalar triple at every address using its fixed ternary pattern value.
scalar_oracle.independence: Expected patterns and all48 coupling rows are reconstructed from research/reference/algebra.py, which uses exact4x4 matrices and has no production imports or copied routing tables. Verify Fv=lambda*v at every address, then compare the native tensor rows to this independent operator before capture. Expected evolution is a scalar arithmetic oracle, never an engine-generated expected state.

effective_ratio_mapping.mapping: For reduced p/q=lambda/6, rho=q*r+j with fixed j in0..q-1 obeys ell,rho_next=divmod(12*p*b+rho,6*q), rho_next=q*r_next+j.
effective_ratio_mapping.scope: This is a mathematical conjugacy of encoded invariant sectors. No generalized-coefficient rule is installed in the native engine. Native six-remainder cases test the sector represented by j=0 under this map; other j sectors are algebraic statements, not additional native initial states in this batch.

readouts.full_state: Every channel triple at every site and every state0..18 must equal the encoded scalar oracle, including zero-pattern remainders.
readouts.inputs: Record the actual native input sum for every address at every update1..18 and compare it with lambda*b*v. Arrays use lexicographic x,y,z,g order, with all48 channels at every node.
readouts.clicks: Retain every native C event, its address, class, quotient, actual input sum and six separate signed donor values in +X,-X,+Y,-Y,+Z,-Z order. Donor addresses are exactly reconstructed from the archived fixed tensor and recipient address. Compare the complete event list to the oracle using the existing nonzero-quotient AND changed-triple guard; no event filtering.
readouts.inverse: Native recorder verifies each inverse transition and the complete final rewind; independent audit reconstructs the full initial state and all transitions.
readouts.period: Report the first exact full-state return to the initial state within1..18 and equality at that lag throughout the available window, or none within the fixed horizon. Never stop at a discovered return or extend a run to obtain a period.

acceptance: All48 cases must be captured completely; every full-state and input-sum comparison and every raw-C event comparison must pass, as must all inverses and full rewinds. A failed criterion is reported with counterexamples. Incomplete cases remain inconclusive. Mathematical all-state closure and finite native checks are reported separately.
boundary_scope: Small periodic cubes are intentional: L3 realizes period3, L4 realizes period4, and uniform/internal patterns need only the minimum valid L3. These are global periodic preparations. No no-wrap or localized-propagation conclusion is drawn.
budget_scope: Whole dedicated wrapper process CPU plus child user/system CPU, including imports, independent algebra preflight, source preservation, native capture, inverse checks, observation, compression, export and final archive hashing. Use complete native checkpoints before decoding or observing. Stop before a new case if fewer than35CPU seconds remain; preserve completed cases and list unrun or unobserved cases explicitly.
estimate: 48 cases contain exactly1586880 channel-state triples across all19 states, before sparse compression. A prior802560-triple dense-mode study used28.569 inner CPU seconds; the new full input and donor audit adds work. This is a sizing estimate, not a promised runtime; whole-process hard limits and case reserves are enforced.
presenter_selection: All four patterns at counter seed(0,1), base remainder2, plus internal_yy at seed(0,1), remainder1, chosen before capture. Retain all cases regardless of outcome.
retention: Preserve frozen protocol, complete executed dependency sources, native recordings, raw C, input arrays, independent scalar traces, all failures, source hashes and archive hashes. Never edit prior frozen research evidence.
